steps.body: The running total is your only cargo — say it after every join, and a long sum becomes a short walk with a full backpack.
steps.narration: The running total is your only cargo — say it after every join, and a long sum becomes a short walk with a full backpack.

widget.prompt: Track the total aloud: from 42, three ten-hops. Say each landing.

commonLandings.feedback: Those were one-steps; each narrated hop banks a full ten.

widget.missFeedback: Each hop adds 10. From 42, 3 hops land on 72.
widget.successFeedback: 52, 62, 72 — three narrated landings, zero lost cargo.

predict.prompt: Halfway through a four-addend sum you pause. What must you still know?
predict.reveal: The total-so-far is the whole state of the sum — with it, any pause is safe.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2n track total.
invariants: Regrouping addends changes the ORDER of joining, never the total — every staging of the sum must land on the same number for g2n track total.
misconceptions: Believing the grouping or order of addends can change a sum, or letting an addend join twice or not at all while restaging.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: Which single change to the staging would actually change the total — and which only changes the path?

explanationVariants: Say the total after each join.

commonErrors.feedback: That skipped ahead to 9 — the addends join in the order you staged.
The total froze; 14 must be folded in before moving on.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Stage the sum: pick a pair, bank the total, and let each remaining addend join one at a time.

hints: Pick a pair and add it.

widget.prompt: You add 17 + 25 + 3 as (17 + 3) + 25. Is the total allowed to change?

options.label: No — regrouping addends never changes a sum
options.feedback: Correct — addition lets you group in any order; 20 + 25 and the left-to-right path both reach 45.

options.label: Yes — the parentheses add extra
options.feedback: Parentheses only choose which pair goes first; they contribute nothing of their own.

options.label: Only if the answer stays under 20
options.feedback: The regrouping freedom has no size limit — it is a property of addition itself.

options.label: Yes — 3 must always join last
options.feedback: That treats position as a rule, but addends own no fixed turn — 17 + 3 first is exactly the friendly-pair move.

hints: Pick a pair and add it.
